verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a hosted PR-review service, so an interactive API reference is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence covers PR comment triggers, rules files, effort levels and git integrations, but documents no API reference, interactive explorer or runnable examples. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes show machine-readable documentation, which is adjacent and not an interactive API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
